preregistration.control_criterion_verbatim: The fitted-model route passes its own known-truth control iff a second-order synthetic source selects order 2 by BIC, the fitted D_k curve has relative RMSE at most 5% against the exact D_k curve for k=5..30, and both fitted and exact curves receive the same LINEAR verdict from the repository fit_growth reference. If this control fails, stop before loading real cached service sequences.

method.route: Fit order 0, 1, and 2 Markov models by BIC; compute D_k exactly under the selected fitted model against its own position-wise marginal product.
method.occupancy_bypass: All conditional probabilities come from fitted low-order contexts; no empirical k-prefix occupancy table is used.

If this control fails, stop before loading real cached service sequences.
known_truth_control.source: synthetic second-order binary Markov chain with known transition table
